brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / editorial sports thumbnail.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball article thumbnail, landscape 16:9, ideally 2048x1152 px. A new hand-drawn illustration, not a photograph.
The reference style already viewed is B-culver-black-lime-v3.png: near-black #151A18 backdrop, vivid lime #CCF43B broad dry-brush slashes, warm ivory bold Japanese typography, sharp black ink and brush portrait drawing, few elements. Use this visual language only, never its old names, date, score, text, or player.

Subject: the real professional basketball player Rapolas Ivanauskas (ラポラス・アイヴァナーカス), selected at random among 23 distinct named players in the fixed article, illustrated with recognizable likeness based on his official 2026-27 B.LEAGUE profile just inspected. Latest profile appearance: fair skin, tall athletic/slender muscular build, elongated angular face, defined squared jaw and chin, straight long nose, blue-grey eyes, dark brown short tousled hair with a longer uneven fringe crossing the forehead, visible brown moustache, mostly clean-shaven cheeks and jaw. Do not substitute a generic/fictitious player. The inspected official profile is https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/2890/2026-27/51000272_03.png and the supporting official club appearance image is https://gambarous.jp/files/user/202606301438_2.jpg . These are appearance references only, do not paste or reproduce any photo, watermark, logos, text, jersey branding, or background people.

Composition: large dynamic three-quarter figure on the RIGHT 42 percent, visibly stepping forward and rotating his torso, gathering one orange basketball firmly in both hands near the right side of his waist/chest before an attacking move; bent elbows, anatomically clear wrists and fingers, broad shoulders, head and likeness clearly readable looking toward the left. Frame from head to upper thigh; all of head, ball, both hands, and elbows inside canvas, avoid cropping critical anatomy. Use a plain unbranded light/ivory sleeveless basketball jersey with black ink shadows, no numbers or lettering. One player only. Sweeping lime brush arc behind him indicates motion. No hoop is necessary. This is an illustrative generic movement, not a recreation of an actual play or any claim about performance on this date.
LEFT 58 percent is a clean spacious typography block with generous safe margins. Small 'バスケまとめ' near top left. Strong date line '11/16'. Very large main headline '試合結果' in warm ivory, and equally legible second headline '当日のEFF' in lime. Below in smaller but clearly legible ivory, on one line if possible, 'リーグ別・ポジション別TOP3'. Plain clean readable sans serif Japanese with heavy bold main headings, not handwritten illegible Japanese. Use black separation from illustration; no text over face or hands.
At bottom left put the readable disclosure 'イラスト（AI生成）' and immediately alongside it 'イメージ'. Both must be fully visible, at least 28px at 1536px width. Avoid tiny disclosure.

Exact text to render (no other words or numeric data):
バスケまとめ
11/16
試合結果
当日のEFF
リーグ別・ポジション別TOP3
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ

Editorial constraints: the only article facts are from the supplied fixed source.html/source.txt: November 16 match results and that day's official EFF top three per league and position. Keep league/position qualifiers. Do not imply overall top three, season average, prediction, or a specific winner. Because the player is randomly selected, DO NOT display his name, his individual statistics, his appearance record, or praise/claims about his performance. No scoreboards, no scores, no jersey numbers, no league or team logo, no sponsor words, no badges, no photorealism. Strong hand-drawn ink strokes and limited palette. Preserve crisp accurate Japanese typography and generous safe margins.

--- 実使用の修正プロンプト（1回） ---
Edit this existing thumbnail with ONE targeted layout correction. Preserve the canvas aspect and resolution (1672x941 PNG), every Japanese text character, all typography positions, black #151A18 and lime #CCF43B brush style, the real player Rapolas Ivanauskas likeness, moustache, hair, original face, body pose, ball and hands. The top of the hair touches/crops against the top edge: slightly reduce and reposition only the entire player-and-ball illustration on the right so that ALL hair and head have at least 40 pixels of black breathing room above and the ball/hand on the right have at least 30 pixels clear space from the right edge. Keep the upper thigh crop at bottom as intentional composition; do not crop the head, elbows, hands, fingers or ball. Do not change face identity, add any people, add logos, change or add text. Keep exact visible wording: バスケまとめ / 11/16 / 試合結果 / 当日のEFF / リーグ別・ポジション別TOP3 / イラスト（AI生成） / イメージ. Return exactly one finished corrected PNG thumbnail.

generator.inspection: 生成結果を実際に目視。日付・見出し・リーグ別/ポジション別の限定を固定本文と照合。選手名/個人成績/出場・活躍の主張なし。公式プロフィールと髪・口ひげ・輪郭を照合。修正後は頭部・両肘・両手・ボールが枠内で、指の形と文字の可読性を確認。イラスト（AI生成）・イメージの明記を確認。ロゴ・公式写真の貼付なし。
